I have implemented [`run_tasks`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-800myk_6/run.py#L12-L108) in [run.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-800myk_6/run.py) (mounted at `/app/run.py` inside the container).

### Key Details
- **Concurrency Control**: Uses an `asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrent)` to bound the number of concurrently running tasks to `max_concurrent`.
- **Graceful Interrupt & Cancellation Cleanup**:
  - Installs a `SIGINT` handler while `run_tasks` is executing so that keyboard interrupts cancel active tasks via the event loop rather than abruptly stopping the loop before async cleanup (`finally` / `except CancelledError` blocks) can complete.
  - Prevents queued tasks waiting on the semaphore from starting once cancellation is triggered.
  - Waits for all in-flight tasks (including their asynchronous cleanup blocks) to finish before propagating `KeyboardInterrupt` or `CancelledError`.
